main_text.head: TYPOGRAPHVS LECTORI.
main_text.p: PRaclarè Oratorum Princeps, Lector benevole, Historiam dixit vitam magistram. Quemadmodum enim sapiens magistra eis, quibus prafecta est, salutaria, qua sequantur, prascribit precepta & viuendi rationes: ita etiam historia practica, qua hominum actiones enarrat voluntarias, rerum praeteritarum proponens veritatem, docet, quid in rebus politicis sit imitandum, quid contra fugiendum. Eam, qua de Rebus Belgicis est, id quoque praestare, qui negauerit, is se eius non admodum peritum esse ostenderit. Nam siue Imperatores, siue Reges, Principes, Respublica, Magistratus, Belli duces, Chiliarcha, Centuriones, Milites gregarii alii, cuiuscunque tandem sint ordinis ac conditio-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "P" is read as P. Text in the title line "TYPOGRAPHVS" is set in roman capitals with "LECTORI." in spaced capitals. The catchword "ditio-" is the last word of the page's final line, so it is treated as the catchword and is also printed at the end of the paragraph above; the running head is absent. Some letters ("praecepta", "prefecta") are slightly blurred; the "s" long s has been rendered as s throughout.
